title: Lenses, the Lens Formula and Power
summary: Convex and concave lenses, 1/v − 1/u = 1/f, magnification and the power of a lens.
objectives: I can use the lens formula and magnification.
I can calculate lens power in dioptres.
I can describe images formed by convex and concave lenses.
misconceptions: The lens formula is the same as the mirror formula.
A concave lens can form a real image of a real object.
